_meta.purpose: Factors of safety for fastened joints (plan 2026-11-02-001).
_meta.decision: Owner 2026-11-02: use 1.5 for fasteners unless an FAA or ASME regulation, standard, or other citable best practice is more conservative.

override_rule: An override needs a REF-ID whose section/paragraph is VERIFIED (not 'requires verification') and a value greater than the default; the tool uses the larger of the default and any applicable override.

candidates_pending_verification.why: search for an ASME bolted-joint or fastener-torque practice; PCC-1 is pressure-flange specific and likely not applicable
